battle.name: 秦州之戰
battle.brief: 開禧三年（1207）五月，南宋李好義乘收復關外四州之勢，率三萬眾進圍秦州城南皂郊堡。金朝遣都統術虎高琪馳援，李好義預伏山谷，軍車分列左右、十字弩伏於車下，詐敗誘敵。金騎分兩部輪番衝擊，又遣精騎自山上馳下合擊，宋軍傷亡慘重，解圍退回關外。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 開禧三年，交戰的兩方是南宋與金朝。南宋方面，寧宗把西部的軍政大權交給四川宣撫司與製置司，洮、岷、階、成等關外軍州名義上歸秦鳳路經略司節制，前線指向秦州與鞏昌；此次進攻秦州的主力是原吳曦部將李好義所率的關外兵眾，隸屬西部軍政序列，卻自成一軍，糧秣與兵源都要由四川方面供應。金朝方面，宣宗聞訊後下詔各路抵禦，命都統術虎高琪率軍自鳳翔、陝西一線西進，馳援秦州。金軍編制仍沿用猛安謀克的老辦法：謀克是百人隊，猛安是千夫長，漢軍與女真、契丹武裝並行編入；野戰以騎兵為骨幹，步卒多為奚人、漢人軍戶，飛石砲與火藥一類的器械待命待用。兩軍在渭水上游的天水盆地隔河相望，秦州是宋金在隴右的接觸點。金廷當時正把主力壓在淮東一線應付宋的北伐，隴右這支部隊是從既有防務調度中抽出的應急兵，所以戰役規模有限，位置卻要緊。
countriesEn: The fighting of 1207 was between the Southern Song and the Jin dynasty, the Jurchen state of North China then under the Taíhé reign era. On the Song side the court in Lin'an kept the military government of the western frontier in the hands of the Sichuan xuanfu and zhizhi offices; the prefecture-level commands of Tao, Min, Jie and Cheng beyond the passes were nominally under the Jinglü authority of Qin Feng circuit, and the line of defence ran through Qin Prefecture and Gongchang. The force that besieged Qin Prefecture in May 1207 was the army Li Haoyi had brought back to the Song after the defection of Wu Xi; it sat inside the western command structure but fought as a separate body, with its troops and grain drawn from Sichuan. On the Jin side, as soon as the news reached the court, the Xuanzong emperor ordered the regional commands to resist and the zongtong Shuhu Gaoqi was sent west from the Fengxiang and Shaanxi line to relieve Qin Prefecture. The Jin field army still used the old meng'an-mo ke organisation, a mo ke being a hundred-man unit and a meng'an a thousand-man command, with Han troops serving in the same lines as Jurchen and Khitan contingents. In the field the cavalry formed the backbone, the foot soldiers were largely Xian and Han military households, and trebuchets and gunpowder appliances stood by for siege work. The two armies faced each other across the Wei valley in the Tianshui basin, where Qin Prefecture was the point of contact between Song and Jin in Longyou. With the Jin court concentrating its strength in Huai-dong to meet the Song northern offensive, the detachment sent to Longyou was an emergency force pulled out of an already overstretched defence, which is why the battle stayed small in scale while remaining important for the ground it was fought over.
people: 李好義是此役宋方的主角。他原為吳曦部將，開禧二年吳曦以四川制置副使身份叛宋降金、獻出關外四州，李好義隨眾反正，於開禧三年三月收復四州，乘勝揮軍北指，五月率三萬眾進圍皂郊堡，並在山谷設伏，以車分列左右、伏弩待發，親率一部出戰詐敗誘敵，最終在金軍精騎自山上馳下的合擊中損失慘重，解圍而退。吳曦是這場糾葛的另一端：他於開禧二年叛宋，把宋在隴右的邊防撕開一個口子；開禧三年春他死於自己部將之手，其所獻之地才被收復，此役的進攻正是收復之後的連續動作。金朝方面，率軍馳援的是都統術虎高琪，他以驍勇善騎見稱，臨陣把騎兵分為兩部輪番出擊，又另遣精騎自山脊馳下合擊，扭轉了戰局。守方的秦州知州與屯堡將士據城而守，牽制了金軍一部兵力。主持宋廷者是韓侂胄，主政金廷者為宣宗完顏永宗。關於此戰的細節主要保存在《續資治通鑑》卷一百五十八，該書由李心傳撰成，是後世核對秦州之戰的原始文字來源。
peopleEn: Li Haoyi is the central figure on the Song side. He had been a commander under Wu Xi; when Wu Xi, deputy commissioner of Sichuan, revolted against the Song in 1206 and handed over the four prefectures beyond the passes, Li Haoyi turned against his former master, recovered those prefectures in March 1207 and marched north on the strength of that success. In May he led thirty thousand men to surround Zaojiao Fort south of Qin Prefecture, chose a ravine as his ambush ground, split his wagons into a left and a right line, hid crossbowmen beneath them, and fought forward with a detachment of his own army in a feigned defeat to draw the Jin into the trap. In the end the Jin picked cavalry coming down off the ridge struck his flank, the Song losses were heavy, and he had to lift the siege and withdraw. Wu Xi stands at the other end of the affair: his defection in 1206 tore a hole in the Song frontier in Longyou, and his death at the hands of his own men in the spring of 1207 was what allowed that ground to be recovered at all, the attack on Qin Prefecture being simply the next step in the recovery. On the Jin side the relief force was led by the zongtong Shuhu Gaoqi, a commander renowned for boldness and horsemanship, who divided his cavalry into two parts for alternating charges and detached a picked body to race down from the ridge and strike in concert, turning the action around. On the Song defensive side the prefect of Qin Prefecture and the garrison of the fort held the walls and tied down part of the Jin force. The war was driven at the Song court by Han Tuozhou, while the Jin emperor Xuanzong, personal name Yongzong, directed the northern response. The finest detail of the engagement survives in volume 158 of the Xu Zizhi Tongjian, written by Li Xinchuan, and that is the primary written source for checking the battle.
kits: 卡面這件十字弩在戰役中的位置很明確，它是宋軍伏陣時的伏弩。開禧三年五月，李好義把輜重用的軍車分列左右當作掩體，弩手伏在車下，箭鏃朝外，等金軍騎兵進入狹窄谷地才近距齊射。弩的優點在這一刻全數發揮：不需要拉弓的臂力，密集射擊準確，伏在低處仍然看得見接近的目標；缺點同樣致命，裝填慢，一發之後要重新上弦、上機，一次齊射之後就是空窗。宋軍自己的用兵邏輯很清楚，弩守城、伏擊、封隘口最可靠，野戰正面對騎兵衝鋒則遠不如長弓連射。宋軍的軍寨體系裡，弩與弓常按比例混編，配套的還有擲臂弩、蹶張弩與更重的神臂弓，寨牆、拒馬鹿角、鐵蒺藜與壕溝把騎兵的速度限制在通道裡，等於替弩手延長了反應時間。金軍那邊相反，優勢全在馬上：札葉甲、鎧甲與馬披護住人馬，角弓或硬弓射出的鳴鏑與骨鏃覆蓋射界，長槊、錘與環首刀用於近身；輪番不斷的衝擊正是為了讓弩手無法喘氣。金軍隨軍還有飛石砲與火藥一類的器械，用於拆壘而非野戰對射。糧道方面，宋軍的輜重車與牛車沿洮水、渭水一路上行，關外四州的糧食供養這支深入敵後的遠征軍隊；金軍自東面沿渭河谷地急行，道路較短。弩、馬、糧，三者的差距就是這場戰役的勝負手。
kitsEn: The crossbow on the card has a clearly defined place in this battle: it was the crossbow of the ambush, the lying bow carried by the ambush line. In May 1207 Li Haoyi set his baggage wagons in a line to the left and the right to serve as cover, the crossbowmen lay beneath the wagons with bolts pointed outward, and they waited until the Jin horsemen were committed in the narrow ravine before firing at close range. Every advantage of the weapon told at that moment: no draw strength required, dense volleys accurate, and men lying low still commanding a view of the approach. The weaknesses were just as fatal. A crossbow is slow to reload; after a single bolt the crew must cock the windlass and reset the lock, and a volley is followed by an empty interval. The Song understood this logic exactly. The crossbow was most reliable on walls, in ambushes and at the mouths of passes where movement was choked, and much weaker than the longbow in open-field fighting against a charge of horsemen. In Song garrison practice bows and crossbows were mixed in fixed proportions and equipped with the thrown crossbow, the windlass crossbow and the heavier shenbi crossbow, while palisades, antlered barricades, iron caltrops and ditches slowed the cavalry into a channel, in effect buying the crossbowmen time to cock their weapons. The Jin were the opposite: their advantage lay on horseback, with lamellar and plate armour and horse chamfrons covering men and mounts, whistling arrows and bone-tipped bolts from horn-laminated and hardwood bows, long spears, maces and ring-pommelled sabres for the close work. The unbroken alternation of charges existed for one purpose, to leave the crossbowmen no time to reload. The Jin column also carried trebuchets and gunpowder appliances, intended to break fortifications rather than to win a field action. In logistics the Song moved baggage carts and ox-carts up the Tao and Wei rivers, and the grain of the four recovered prefectures fed an army operating far behind its own lines, while the Jin rode west along the Wei valley from the east over a shorter road. Crossbow, horse and grain: the distance between those three things decided the battle.
tactics: 宋軍的戰術是一套完整的伏擊流程。三月收復關外四州之後，李好義沒有沿大路直趨秦州，而是取山谷小道北進，五月抵達秦州城南皂郊堡，先行圍堡，再就地設伏。佈陣的核心是把車陣當成牆：軍車分為左右兩列，車軸之間留出通道，弩手伏在車下，步卒在車陣之後列，騎兵與旗隊壓住谷口。作戰時李好義自率一部出陣接戰，交手不久即作敗退之狀，把追擊的金軍引入谷中；金騎進入伏圈後，車下弩手近距離齊射，箭雨壓住衝鋒的節奏，左右兩翼車陣隨即合攏，切斷退路，宋軍主力掩殺上來，把金軍擊退。金軍的應對同樣有章法，先結陣自保，以密集的騎槊與拒馬擋住追擊，待隊形重整之後再反攻。術虎高琪把騎兵分為兩部輪番出擊，輪番的目的不是一舉衝垮，而是消耗宋軍人力、迫使其不斷變換陣形，趁宋軍疲於應付正面之時，另遣一支精騎自山脊馳下，衝向宋軍側背，兩部會合合擊。宋軍此時攻守已易位，車陣的遮蔽只能護住正面，擺在谷中的主力側翼暴露，被精騎一插便告崩解，傷亡慘重，最後解圍退去。這種以山脊奇兵制勝的做法，後來在北方草原軍隊手中被放大成更完整的戰法。
tacticsEn: The Song engagement was a complete ambush procedure. After retaking the four prefectures in March, Li Haoyi did not march up the main road towards Qin Prefecture but took the tracks through the ravines, reached Zaojiao Fort south of the prefecture in May, investeded the fort first and only then set his ambush in place. The core of the deployment was to use the wagon train as a wall: the wagons were divided into a left and a right line, gaps between the axles left open as lanes, the crossbowmen lay under the wagons, infantry stood behind the wagon line, and cavalry with the banners held the mouth of the ravine. Li Haoyi then led a detachment forward to make contact and, after a short exchange, pretended to be beaten, drawing the pursuing Jin into the ravine. Once the cavalry was inside the trap the crossbowmen beneath the wagons fired at close range, an arrow storm blunted the pace of the charge, the two lines of wagons closed in to cut the retreat, and the Song main body followed up and killed the routed Jin. The Jin response was just as methodical: they first closed ranks and stood their ground, using the dense forest of spears and barricades to stop the pursuit, and only counterattacked once their formation had been restored. Shuhu Gaoqi split his cavalry into two parts for alternating attacks, and the point of the alternation was not to break the Song in one charge but to wear down their numbers and force continual rearrangement of the formation, while the Song were busy with the front a picked body rode down from the ridge into their flank, the two parts joining in a combined stroke. By then offence and defence had been reversed: the wagon line protected only the front, the main body drawn up in the ravine had its flank exposed, and once the picked cavalry drove in the line dissolved, losses were heavy, the siege was abandoned and the army withdrew. The use of a ride down the ridge to break an ambush was later developed on a far greater scale by the armies of the northern steppe.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但有幾個是硬數。進攻方兵力方面，宋軍三萬，《續資治通鑑》卷一百五十八記李好義率三萬眾圍皂郊堡，這是本戰唯一明確的兵力記載；金軍人數各書不載，只能從術虎高琪分兵兩部輪番出擊、又另遣精騎迂迴山後推知其騎兵為作戰主力，具體數目無從核實。時間線是：吳曦降金在開禧二年，關外四州收復在開禧三年三月，皂郊堡之戰在同年五月，前後銜接約兩個月。地理方面，秦州即今甘肅天水，皂郊堡在州城南數十里，沿渭水河谷；金軍自鳳翔出發，順渭河谷西行至秦州，道路里程約四百里；宋軍大本營在成都，自成都到關外四州再到秦州，行程逾千餘里，已是深入敵後的距離。地形與氣候方面，五月關中渭水進入汛期，山谷多雨霧，谷中稍寬處不過數十步，車陣正好橫在寬處。沒有記載的數字是宋軍傷亡人數與金軍損失，兩書均無數目，只能說宋軍傷亡慘重。最後是這場戰役最硬的一個結果數字：秦州與皂郊堡都沒有失守。
dataEn: Few figures can be verified, but a few are hard. On the strength of the attackers: thirty thousand Song troops, for volume 158 of the Xu Zizhi Tongjian records Li Haoyi leading thirty thousand men to surround Zaojiao Fort, and that is the only explicit strength figure for the battle. The size of the Jin army is given in no source; it can only be inferred from the fact that Shuhu Gaoqi split his cavalry into two for alternating charges and detached a picked body to swing round behind the ridge, so that cavalry was the fighting core, though the exact number cannot be established. The chronology runs: the defection of Wu Xi in 1206, the recovery of the four prefectures in March 1207, and the action at Zaojiao in May of the same year, a sequence of roughly two months. In geography, Qin Prefecture is modern Tianshui in Gansu, Zaojiao Fort stands some tens of li south of the prefecture along the Wei valley; the Jin marched out of Fengxiang and up the valley westward, a road of about four hundred li, while the Song base lay at Chengdu, and the march from Chengdu to the four prefectures and on to Qin Prefecture exceeded a thousand li, an operation already deep behind its own lines. On terrain and season, in May the Wei was in flood, the ravines were wet and foggy, and the open part of the valley was no more than a few dozen paces across, which is exactly where the wagon line was planted. The figures that are not recorded are the Song casualties and the Jin losses; neither appears in the sources, and only the statement that the Song suffered heavy losses survives. Finally, the one hard result figure that matters: neither Qin Prefecture nor Zaojiao Fort was lost.
cause: 打起來的根由有三層。最外層是宋的開禧北伐：開禧二年韓侂胄主持北伐，分路出師攻金，一度攻入泗、宿兩州，進逼蔡州，金廷被迫把主力調到淮東與江淮一線，隴右的守備因此變薄，這給了金朝在西北反擊的機會。中間一層是吳曦之叛：吳曦以四川制置副使身份叛宋降金，獻出宋在關外的階、成、洮、岷四州，隴右邊防從此由宋轉入金手，秦州、鞏昌一線變成真正的前線，宋廷在關外的經營幾乎被抹平；開禧三年春吳曦死於部將之手，四州在三月被李好義收復，宋的西部邊線一度回復。最內一層是進攻的時機與目標：關外四州剛復，守軍久疲、糧秣未集，宋廷與四川宣撫司仍想乘勢取秦州，把秦鳳路前線重新推到隴山東麓，一舉解決自吳曦叛宋以來的邊患。但宋廷忽略了戰場本質的改變，金軍已能以整建制的騎兵在關中河谷內快速機動並集中兵力，而宋軍遠在關外，補給線拉得過長，攻城器械不足，更沒有算到金軍會以精騎越山奇襲這種方式直插伏陣的側背。三層原因疊在一起，決定了秦州必然成為雙方必爭之地，也決定了李好義的伏擊必然在半天之內被破解。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason behind the fighting. The outermost was the Song's Kaixi northern offensive: in 1206, under Han Tuozhou, the Song sent its columns north against the Jin, briefly taking Si and Su prefecture and pressing towards Cai Prefecture, which forced the Jin court to shift its main strength to the Huai and Jianghuai lines and left the Longyou garrisons thin, giving the Jin its opening in the northwest. The middle layer was the defection of Wu Xi: as deputy commissioner of Sichuan he went over to the Jin and surrendered the Song's four prefectures beyond the passes, Jie, Cheng, Tao and Min, so that the frontier in Longyou passed from Song into Jin hands, Qin Prefecture and Gongchang became a real front line, and the Song presence outside the passes was almost wiped out. Wu Xi was killed by his own men in the spring of 1207, the four prefectures were retaken by Li Haoyi in March, and the Song western line was briefly restored. The innermost layer was timing and objective: with the four prefectures just recovered, their garrisons were exhausted and their grain had not yet been gathered, yet the court and the Sichuan xuanfu office still hoped to take Qin Prefecture in the same movement, push the line back to the eastern foot of the Long mountains and end the trouble Wu Xi's revolt had created. What the Song failed to take into account was the changed nature of the battlefield. The Jin could now concentrate whole cavalry formations and move them quickly through the valleys of Guanzhong, while the Song army stood far out beyond the passes with a supply line stretched too thin and too few siege appliances; nor had anyone reckoned on the Jin sending picked cavalry over the ridge to fall straight onto the flank of the ambush. All three layers together meant that Qin Prefecture had to be fought for, and also that Li Haoyi's ambush had to break within hours.
impact: 秦州之戰的直接結果是宋軍攻勢受挫，但它在宋金戰爭中的位置遠比一場邊境小戰為大。第一，它替宋廷的北伐收了尾：宋軍在關外的攻勢到此為止，關外四州守住了，秦州卻沒有拿下來，隔年便有嘉定和議，宋金恢復沿淮水與大散關一線的分界，歲幣增加，北伐的政治目標全部落空。第二，它把對宋作戰與防禦蒙古的重疊擺到宋廷面前：同一條渭水谷道，東面接金、西面壓宋，而北面蒙古的影子已經越過陰山；後來蒙古軍正是循著關中與四川的山道一路南下，十三世紀三十年代蒙古軍西進時，秦州、鞏昌、階、成一線的堡寨成為宋軍最後的骨架。第三，它在戰術上留下一個教訓，伏弩車陣能夠在狹窄地形拖住騎兵，卻無法應付兩面同時受敵，金軍以輪番消耗加上山後奇襲破解伏陣，後來蒙古人用回回炮、繩梯與更嚴密的圍城戰術把這種優勢放大。第四，它延後了宋金邊界西段的穩定期，讓秦鳳、洮、岷一線維持了二十餘年的邊境屯戍體系，直到蒙古到來才被徹底改寫。
impactEn: The direct result was that the Song attack was checked, but the place of Qin Prefecture in the Song-Jin war was far greater than that of a small frontier action. First, it closed the northern offensive: the Song drive beyond the passes ended here, the four prefectures were held, Qin Prefecture was not taken, and the following year came the Jiading peace settlement, with the Song-Jin border re-established along the Huai and the Dasan Pass, the tribute increased, and every political aim of the offensive abandoned. Second, it showed the Song court that fighting the Song's war and fighting the Mongols overlapped on the same ground: the Wei valley road ran east to the Jin and west against the Song, while the Mongol shadow had already crossed the Yin mountains. The Mongols later came down precisely these roads through Guanzhong and Sichuan, and in the 1230s, when they drove west, the line of forts at Qin Prefecture, Gongchang, Jie and Cheng became the last skeleton of Song resistance. Third, it left a tactical lesson: a wagon line with crossbowmen lying in wait could hold horsemen in narrow ground but could not cope with pressure on two fronts at once, and the Jin broke the ambush by alternating pressure with a ride down the ridge behind it, a method the Mongols later enlarged with counterweight trebuchets, rope ladders and far stricter siege discipline. Fourth, it prolonged the stable period on the western Song-Jin frontier and kept the garrison system of the Qin Feng, Tao and Min line in place for more than twenty years, until the arrival of the Mongols rewrote it entirely.
result: 戰果很清楚，金軍守住了秦州與皂郊堡，宋軍敗退。術虎高琪的兩路騎兵輪番消耗，加上自山脊馳下的精騎合擊，把李好義的伏陣打成崩潰；宋軍傷亡慘重，圍攻中止，部隊退回關外四州。這一場沒有改變秦州一線的實際控制，兩軍仍以渭水谷道為界，金朝保住鳳翔以西的緩衝，宋廷則失去了趁四州收復之勢把前線推回隴山東麓的機會。事後金朝在秦鳳邊界加緊守備，收納了吳曦餘部與散兵；宋廷在關外重整編制，把新收的階、成、洮、岷四州交給四川宣撫司節制，同時加快與金的和議，開禧三年末韓侂胄被殺，嘉定元年宋金訂和約，宋增歲幣、稱伯侄之國，戰事全面停止。從器械的角度看，這場戰役也替後世留下一份清單：弩手伏於車下、以窄地限制騎兵衝鋒的路子有效，但必須配足弩矢、留足上弦的時間，並且在山谷地形裡安排第二道防線，否則一支部曲的側後被精騎插入就足以讓整個伏圈瓦解。往後的宋蒙戰爭，弩依然是守城、拒馬與打騎兵的第一線武器，只是用法從伏擊改成了固定陣地。
resultEn: The outcome is plain: the Jin held Qin Prefecture and Zaojiao Fort and the Song withdrew. Shuhu Gaoqi's two-part alternating cavalry, reinforced by the picked riders who came down off the ridge and struck in concert, broke Li Haoyi's ambush; Song losses were heavy, the siege was lifted and the army fell back to the four prefectures beyond the passes. Nothing changed in the actual control of the Qin Prefecture line, which stayed divided along the Wei valley road, the Jin keeping the buffer west of Fengxiang and the Song losing the chance to push the line back to the eastern foot of the Long mountains on the strength of the recapture. Afterwards the Jin tightened the Qin Feng frontier and took in Wu Xi's remaining followers and stragglers; the Song reorganised the command outside the passes, placed the newly recovered Jie, Cheng, Tao and Min prefectures under the Sichuan xuanfu office, and at the same time pressed for negotiations with the Jin. Han Tuozhou was killed at the end of 1207, and in 1208 the Song-Jin peace was concluded, with increased tribute and the Song addressed as a junior nephew state, bringing the fighting to an end. In terms of equipment the battle also left a checklist for later generations: crossbowmen lying under the wagons and using narrow ground to check cavalry worked, but only with enough bolts, enough time for cocking, and a second line of defence laid out in the ravine, since a single body of troops having its rear flank entered by picked cavalry was enough to dissolve an entire ambush. In the later Song-Mongol wars the crossbow remained the first-line weapon for holding walls, facing cavalry and breaking up charges, though its use shifted from ambush to fixed positions.
